* '''Source publication''' ([[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (V) (ALT)]]): Card image published 13 July 2023<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/dagobahyodashut_ai.png</code> ([https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/2e6b92fecff4d08d9a08ec90a6634eeec690dd6b/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/dagobahyodashut_ai.png holotable commit 2e6b92f], 13 July 2023) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same image).</ref>: “Light: If Yoda here or [Set 16] Yoda 'communing,' Broken Concentration is canceled and, once per turn, you may subtract 2 from attrition against you.” '''What changed:''' The PC re-uploaded the image the same day turned to landscape (the way location cards are shown); the card itself is unchanged (the first upload showed the card standing upright, rotated 90°).
